newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama consumer prices dip 0.4 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Panama consumer prices dip 0.4 pct in March.

text.p: Panama's consumer price index dipped 0.4 percent in March after being unchanged in February, the Comptroller General's office said.

Inflation over the past 12 months slowed to 1.4 percent compared with 1.3 percent in the year to March 1996, it said in a release. Cumulative inflation for the first quarter of 1997 now stands at 0.3 percent.
Economists attribute Panama's low inflation primarily to its use of the U.S. dolar as national currency and long-standing wage and price control policies.
